note: Sample attendee profiles for demos and tests. None of these is a real person. Topics are topic labels and are resolved against the conference's topics index at seed time; a label that does not resolve is skipped with a warning. Each entry in share is an index into shared_talks, whose titles are resolved against the conference's talks at seed time. The seed script can replace shared_talks with --talk.
